checks.label: not up two days in a row
checks.threshold: up_run <= 1, counting days above +1.0%; veto at 3+ up closes of any size

checks.label: linearity of the prior leg
checks.threshold: ER >= 0.4 or R2 >= 0.55 (both for A+); failing is a veto

checks.label: young trend: first or second breakout
checks.threshold: prior breakouts since the move started <= 1 (0 for A+)

checks.label: narrow or negative day before
checks.threshold: prior day negative or range < 2.0% (A+: negative and under its 20-session median range)
checks.note: the session before the burst was up and not narrow

checks.label: consolidation quality
checks.display: base_sessions=12 breakdowns=1 bursts_in_base=0 giveback=0.33 tightness=0.97 base_volume_vs_leg=0.85 base_volume_vs_avg=0.85
checks.threshold: base 3-20 sessions, breakdowns <= 1, giveback <= 0.34, tightness <= 1.0 (A+: 0 breakdowns, 0 bursts inside, giveback <= 0.25, tightness <= 0.7, base volume under the leg's and the 50-session average)

checks.label: close near the high
checks.threshold: close_pos >= 0.8 and close > open (A+ >= 0.9; partial from 0.7)

checks.label: range expansion
checks.threshold: today's range over the largest of the prior 5 >= 1.0 (A+: also over the prior 10)
checks.note: the burst bar is not the widest of the last five

checks.label: higher volume
checks.threshold: volume > prior session (A+: rank <= 3 of the last 60); a base over 21 sessions also needs >= 1.5x the 50-session average
checks.note: volume did not exceed the prior session's

notes: extension: close 1.4% vs its 20-SMA, 1.9% over 20 sessions
prior breakouts worked 1 of 2 (closed higher 3 sessions later, last 4 in 60 sessions)

claude.reason: The signal bar itself is the decisive problem: RE and VOL both fail, meaning the burst bar is narrower than the prior five bars and volume came in at only 56% of the prior session — there is no expansion of either range or participation to confirm a genuine burst. The base is 12 sessions with tightness of 0.97 and giveback of 0.33, which is borderline loose by the proxy, and the chart shows the shaded box contains several overlapping red and green bars without a clean compression. Two of three quality checks that matter most for momentum burst conviction (RE and VOL) are recorded FAILs.
claude.key_risk: Without range expansion or volume confirmation, any follow-through depends entirely on the prior trend's momentum, which has already run 34% over 53 sessions and may be exhausted.
claude.entry_note: Skip if the open is below the signal day's close of 69.56 or if the first 30 minutes show no buying interest and price drifts back toward the base high near 72.
